candidates.statement: Checkout 502s trace to redis.reserve_inventory timeouts (DependencyUnavailable) in inventory, reached via order; each checkout fails after ~2s, matching the observed 502 durations.
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side metrics/logs not observed; gateway dependency metric series empty, so redis saturation vs network cause is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts propagating inventory 503 -> order 502 -> checkout 502, consistent with the alert's ~2s 502s. Gateway metrics show checkout p95 ~2387ms and 502s. Topology confirms gateway->order->inventory->redis. Redis-side telemetry is absent, so the bounded candidate is redis-timeout.
